recipes.title: Chairman Mao Pork
steps: Cut pork belly into 3.5x1.5cm pieces (easier if partially frozen)
Brown pork skin-side up in lightly oiled pan
Layer half ginger and spring onion in clay pot, add pork skin-side down
Add soy sauce, wine, and rock sugar
Add remaining ginger and spring onion, cover with water
Bring to boil on high heat, then simmer on low-medium for 30 minutes
Flip pork skin-side up and cover for another 30 minutes
Steam without lid for 45 minutes
Serve with rice

recipes.title: Chive Boxes (Jiu Cai He Zi 韭菜盒子)
steps: Mix flour with cold water, rest 10 minutes, then knead until smooth
Fry scallions in oil until golden brown
Pour soy sauce into hot scallion oil and set aside
Clean shrimp and soak in scallion-ginger water
Mix pork with cooled soy-oil mixture, ginger, pepper, and seasoning
Add shrimp and chives to pork mixture, stir in sesame oil
Divide dough into 60g pieces and roll into 12cm circles
Fill each circle with mixture, seal edges, and pleat
Gently flatten with rolling pin
Pan fry until puffed and golden on both sides

recipes.title: Chicken with Butter Beans and Spinach
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C
Season and brown chicken pieces in oil
Add garlic cut-side down and sliced leeks
Add white wine and bubble for 2 minutes
Pour in stock and add thyme sprigs
Add drained butter beans and spinach, season to taste
Bake covered for 35-40 minutes until chicken is cooked
Rest for 5 minutes before serving

recipes.title: Slow-Roast Pork Belly with Fennel
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C
Score pork belly in diamond pattern and season generously
Heat fennel and spices in roasting tray
Brown pork skin-side down for 5 minutes
Flip, season, and add fennel seeds
Deglaze pan with white wine
Add stock until it reaches the fat line
Roast for 2.5 hours until tender
Rest meat for 10 minutes
Make gravy by whisking mustard into pan juices

recipes.title: Lemongrass Prawns with Zucchini Salad
steps: Combine lemongrass, ginger, garlic, chilli, lime juice, coriander, and olive oil
Add prawns and marinate for 15-30 minutes
Cook prawns on hot grill or pan for 1-2 minutes each side
Toss all salad ingredients together
Serve prawns over salad

recipes.title: Chilli Crab
steps: Cut each crab into 6 pieces and crack shells
Heat oil and stir-fry onion, chilli, garlic, ginger, and spring onion for 1 minute
Add crab pieces and toss to coat
Add tomato, rice wine, sugar, and kecap manis
Cover and steam for 4 minutes
Serve with kaffir lime leaves and fresh coriander

recipes.title: Egg and Mushroom Puff Pastry Tarts
steps: Preheat oven to 220°C
Cut pastry into 4 rectangles and fold borders up slightly
Prick pastry bases with fork
Crack 2 eggs into each tart, top with onion, tomato, and parmesan
Bake for 15 minutes until eggs are set and pastry is golden
While baking, sauté mushrooms in olive oil for 5 minutes
Serve tarts topped with mushrooms, a dollop of pesto, and rocket

recipes.title: Berry Sheet Pancake
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C
Whisk together dry ingredients: flour, sugar, bicarb soda
Whisk together wet ingredients: buttermilk, egg, vanilla, melted butter
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed
Butter a large tray and spread batter evenly
Top with half the berries and dot with butter
Bake for 10 minutes until golden
Flash grill for 1-2 minutes until slightly crispy
Dust with icing sugar, serve with remaining berries, cream, and syrup

recipes.title: Char Siu Bao (BBQ Pork Buns)
steps: Activate yeast: mix with ¼ cup water, 1 tbsp sugar, let sit 10 minutes
Mix dough: flour, cornflour, 4 tbsp sugar, combine with yeast mixture and ½ cup water
Add oil and knead in stand mixer for 3 minutes
Let dough rise for 2 hours until doubled
Add baking powder and mix gently
Prepare filling: fry eschalots in oil, add soy/oyster/sesame sauces and water, thicken with cornflour slurry, add char siu
Divide dough into 12 pieces
Roll each into 11cm circle, place 1½ tbsp filling in center
Pleat and seal edges, place pleated-side up on parchment squares
Rest 15 minutes
Steam for 12 minutes

recipes.title: Wild Mushroom Toast
steps: Cook mushrooms in batches in hot oil until golden, season with salt and pepper
Sauté finely chopped chilli and toss with mushrooms and parsley
Combine ricotta and spreadable cheese
Spread cheese mixture on toasted baguette slices
Top with mushroom mixture and serve

recipes.title: Lobster Salad with Saffron Dressing
steps: Infuse saffron in hot water for 5 minutes
Mix saffron liquid with mayonnaise, lemon juice, horseradish, and mustard
Cook asparagus until tender-crisp, about 2 minutes
Toss salad greens, tomatoes, avocado, onion, and herbs
Top salad with fresh lobster meat
Drizzle with saffron dressing and serve

recipes.title: Spinach & Gruyère Potato Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 230°C
Toss potatoes and fennel with oil, roast 20-25 minutes
Whisk eggs, cream, cheese, basil, and parsley together
Mince garlic and combine with roasted vegetables and spinach
Fold into egg mixture
Pour into baking dish, cover with foil
Bake for 30-35 minutes covered
Uncover and bake 5 minutes until set

recipes.title: BBQ Prawns with Mango Mayonnaise
steps: Prepare marinade with chilli, ginger, coriander, lemongrass, and oil
Marinate prawns for 15 minutes
Blend mango with birdseye chilli, mustard, and egg yolk
Slowly whisk in vegetable oil to emulsify
Finish mango mayo with lime juice
BBQ prawns for 1-2 minutes each side
Serve with mango mayonnaise

recipes.title: Cheesy Baked Asparagus
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C
Layer asparagus spears in baking dish
Pour cream over and scatter minced garlic
Season with salt and pepper
Top with combined parmesan and mozzarella
Sprinkle with red pepper flakes
Bake for 25-30 minutes until asparagus is tender and cheese is bubbly

recipes.title: Chicken and Prosciutto Panzanella
steps: Toast ciabatta for 15 minutes, drizzle with garlic oil, rub with rosemary
Season and cook chicken breasts for 5 minutes each side, rest and slice
Make vinaigrette by whisking vinegar, oil, capers, and mustard
Roughly chop toasted bread and toss vegetables
Combine salad, bread, chicken, and prosciutto
Dress with vinaigrette and fresh basil

recipes.title: Mud Crab with Chilli Sauce
steps: Prepare crab by cutting into serving pieces and cracking shells
Blend paste: red onion, garlic, and red chillies
Heat oil and fry paste for 5 minutes until fragrant
Add crab pieces and toss to coat
Add passata, stock, palm sugar, vinegar, and soy sauce
Simmer for 10 minutes, covered
Thicken with cornflour slurry if needed
Temper with beaten egg by slowly pouring in while stirring
Garnish with spring onions, coriander, and chillies

recipes.title: Red Curry Sea Bass
steps: Shred spring onions lengthwise and crisp in ice water
Score fish on both sides and rub with curry paste
Stuff cavity with fresh coriander stalks
Fry fish for 3-4 minutes on each side until skin is crispy
Serve with lime wedges and crispy spring onions

recipes.title: Chinese Garlic Chive Pancake
steps: Fry spring onion whites in oil until brown and fragrant
Add soy sauce to hot oil and set aside for garnish
Make dough with flour and lukewarm water, rest 10 minutes
Season pork mince with ginger, spring onion greens, and soy sauce
Add chopped garlic chives and sesame oil to pork
Roll out 60g dough pieces into 12cm circles
Fill with 1½ tbsp pork mixture, seal edges tightly
Gently flatten with rolling pin
Pan fry on medium-high heat until golden and puffy on both sides

recipes.title: Chinese Stew Beef and Potato
steps: Blanch beef brisket in cold water with spring onion, orange peel, and vinegar until foamy, then drain and rinse
Fry rock sugar in a pot until caramelized
Add dried aromatics, garlic, ginger, and beef, stir until beef is colored with dark soy
Add cooking wine and enough water to cover
Pressure cook for 45 minutes until tender
Make bean sauce by frying black bean sauce and yellow bean sauce
Combine sauce with beef and cook another 20 minutes in pressure cooker
Strain cooking liquid, return beef and sauce to pot
Air fry potatoes and carrots until cooked
Add potatoes and carrots, simmer until sauce is sticky
Add green pepper at the end
Serve in clay pot, garnish with sliced onion

recipes.title: Chinese Stew Tofu
steps: Break tofu into irregular pieces by hand
Stir fry ginger and spring onion in pork lard and chicken fat until fragrant
Add star anise
Add light soy sauce until fragrant
Add cooking wine
Add water or soup stock
Add oyster sauce
Add sugar and white pepper
Add tofu pieces
Bring to boil then simmer gently for 30 minutes
Serve hot

recipes.title: Winter Black Rice Drink
steps: Boil black glutinous rice in 800ml water for 30 minutes
Add pitted red dates and rock sugar
Cook for 5 more minutes
Add more water if needed for desired consistency
Add oatmeal
Blend in food processor until smooth or chunky as preferred
Add nuts and serve warm

recipes.title: Chinese-Style Beef Tendon
steps: Blanch beef tendons in boiling water until surface is clean
Slow cook with all spices and sauces for 8 hours, or pressure cook until very tender, or cook in clay pot in oven for 12 hours at low temperature
Remove tendons from cooking broth
Slice when cooled to room temperature
Mix remaining stock with vinegar, chilli oil, and soy sauce
Serve tendons at room temperature or reheat in oven for a few minutes
Pour sauce over top and garnish with fried garlic and scallions

recipes.title: Cherry Almond Biscuits
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C
Mix egg whites, ground almonds, caster sugar, vanilla essence, and almond essence
Roll mixture into walnut-sized balls
Coat each ball in icing sugar
Flatten slightly and place on lined baking tray
Top each with a cherry half
Bake for 7-10 minutes until set but still soft

recipes.title: Cheese Biscuits
steps: Process butter, cheese, flour, paprika, salt, and rosemary in food processor until mixture resembles breadcrumbs
Form into a ball and divide in half
Shape each half into a 3cm diameter log
Wrap in plastic and refrigerate for 1 hour
Preheat oven to 200°C (non-fan)
Slice logs into 5mm thick pieces
Place on baking tray
Bake for 12-15 minutes until pale golden
Dust with salt and pepper while still warm

recipes.title: Gruyère Bacon Spinach Scrambled Eggs
steps: Whisk eggs with Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp water, salt, and pepper
Heat oil or butter in skillet over medium heat
Add bacon pieces and cook until crispy
Pour in egg mixture and stir gently for 2-3 minutes
Fold in spinach and Gruyère cheese
Continue cooking until eggs are just set
Serve immediately

recipes.title: Panettone Chocolate Cherry Trifle
steps: Soak cherries in Marsala for at least 30 minutes
Heat half the cream until steaming
Chop 150g chocolate and melt in hot cream, set aside for ganache
Whisk crème fraîche, icing sugar, and remaining cold cream until soft peaks form
Layer in serving glasses: panettone, cherries with Marsala, ganache, cream mixture
Repeat layers finishing with cream
Drizzle extra ganache on top and shave remaining chocolate
Dust with icing sugar and serve chilled

recipes.title: Marble Cheesecake
steps: Preheat oven to 160°C
Mix crushed biscuits with melted butter and press into springform pan base
Process cream cheese, sour cream, and caster sugar until smooth
Beat in eggs one at a time
Add vanilla extract
Transfer 1⅓ cups to separate bowl and mix with melted dark chocolate
Pour half plain batter into base
Dollop half chocolate batter on top
Pour remaining plain batter
Dollop remaining chocolate batter
Swirl with a knife for marbled effect
Bake for 1 hour until center is just set
Cool completely in oven with door propped open
Refrigerate overnight before serving

recipes.title: Garlic Chilli Prawns
steps: Blanch whole chillies and garlic cloves in water for 20 minutes
Drain and blend with 50ml olive oil and lime juice until smooth
Heat 100ml olive oil in wide pan until very hot
Fry prawns for 2-3 minutes until starting to color
Add chilli-garlic sauce and simmer for 2 minutes
Serve with sourdough and fresh lemon wedges

recipes.title: Octopus Carpaccio
steps: Boil water with aromatics (onion, celery, carrot, peppercorns, juniper, bay leaves)
Dip octopus tentacles into boiling water 4-5 times until tender
Simmer gently for 70-90 minutes until very tender
Compress cooked octopus in glass bottle and refrigerate 24 hours
Slice tentacles 1-4mm thick
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil, sea salt, and pepper
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve as appetizer

recipes.title: Jollof Fried Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken strips in buttermilk and Jollof spice mix for 1-2 hours (overnight preferred)
Mix cornflour with all seasonings
Coat marinated chicken pieces in cornflour mixture
Heat oil in deep pan until hot
Fry chicken for 3-4 minutes until golden and cooked through
Drain on paper towels and serve hot

recipes.title: Smoked Pork Porchetta Roll
steps: Season pork middle generously with sea salt, pepper, and garlic powder
Roll pork around julienned onions and tie securely with butcher's twine
Smoke or slow roast until internal temperature reaches 160°C
Caramelize remaining onions with balsamic vinegar until syrupy
Toss arugula with lemon zest, lemon juice, and olive oil
Slice porchetta and serve with caramelized onions and arugula salad

recipes.title: Pan-Seared Scallops with Butternut Purée
steps: Roast butternut squash at 200°C for 45 minutes to 1 hour until tender
Blend roasted squash with butter and herbs into smooth purée
Make vinaigrette: whisk quince paste, shallot, apple cider vinegar, and olive oil
Toss shredded cabbage with half the vinaigrette
Toss slaw with pomegranate seeds, hazelnuts, and fresh mint
Season scallops with salt and pepper
Sear scallops in hot oil for 2 minutes per side until golden
Plate with butternut purée, slaw, and remaining vinaigrette

recipes.title: Chinese Black Bean Oil
steps: Dry roast black beans in pan over medium heat (no oil or water) until fragrant, about 5 minutes
Heat oil in separate pot until shimmering
Add peeled garlic cloves and cook on high heat until beginning to brown, then reduce to low
Continue cooking garlic on low heat until golden brown and crispy, about 15-20 minutes
Add minced ginger and sliced spring onion
Stir in roasted black beans
Add chicken powder and sugar
Cool completely before storing in glass jar
Use as condiment for dumplings, noodles, or rice

recipes.title: 湖南小炒肉 (Hunan Stir-Fried Pork)
steps: Use quick knife technique to slice red chillies into rings, set aside
Slice pork belly and lean pork very thin
Dry fry chilli slices on medium heat without oil until soft and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes
Heat oil in wok or large pan over high heat
Add minced garlic and stir briefly
Add pork belly and stir fry until fat renders and meat begins to color
Add lean pork and stir fry until color changes
Add the dry fried chillies and stir fry together for 2 minutes
Season with sea salt and homemade seasoning powder
Add steamed fish soy sauce and serve immediately

recipes.title: 炒牛肉 (Stir-Fried Beef with Peppers)
steps: Slice beef thin and marinate with cooking wine, minced ginger, egg white, and oyster sauce for 30 minutes
Cut peppers into rings or chunks
Slide marinated beef in hot oil for about 2 minutes until lightly cooked, remove and set aside
Add minced ginger and garlic to pan and stir fry until fragrant
Add spicy beef sauce and fry until red oil appears
Return beef to pan with pepper pieces
Season with seasoning powder and sea salt
Stir fry on high heat for 2 minutes until peppers are slightly softened
Taste and adjust seasoning, serve immediately
